integrity: The proof is analytic and uses exact edge-distance monotonicity and circle-line intersection counts. The acute-triangle lower bound was independently reconstructed from strict local maxima of distance on the boundary. The UCL thesis is dated March 2013, but no exact public-deposit day was verified; the exact source anchor therefore uses the journal article online date 2013-05-08.
scientific_limitations: The bound \(2n-4\) is not claimed sharp for every polygon size, and no complete classification of quadrilaterals or pentagons is claimed. The universal convex-body problem remains open in the inspected source.
title: A polygon-complexity bound for the Erdős circle-intersection invariant
